errors.evidence: The pie chart is visually divided into three sectors, not five. While the legend lists five categories, only three are represented with slices in the chart.

errors.text_span: зелено за „Не съм съгласен“ и лилаво за „Изобщо не съм съгласен“ — двете последни сектора не са етикетирани с проценти, но визуално заемат много малък дял от диаграмата, като зеленият е най-малък, а лилавият е леко по-голям от него.
errors.evidence: The description invents the existence of green and purple sectors and even compares their supposed sizes. The pie chart does not contain any green or purple slices; the sum of the visible percentages (47.6% + 33.3% + 19% = 99.9%) confirms there are no other significant sectors.

errors.text_span: а останалите следват по часовниковата стрелка
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are arranged in descending order of size in a clockwise direction. This is incorrect. Starting from the largest sector (blue, 47.6%), the next sector clockwise is the smallest one (orange, 19%), not the middle-sized one (red, 33.3%).
